data.statement: The dog toy earns its clean Arm A stop through actual use and category collision: a natural golden retriever carry moment makes the fuzzy slipper silhouette read like pet-fashion runway styling while preserving the exact product and requiring no overlay text.
data.decision: Keep the gallery-runway artifact as this run's only survivor, reject the truthful but more static mudroom still and the ungenerated velvet-lobby portrait, and stop without a model revision.
